from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence

from typing import Any, cast

DOMAIN_COMPATIBILITY_SCHEMA_SHA256 = "@@SCHEMA_SHA256@@"
DOMAIN_COMPATIBILITY_POLICY_SHA256 = "@@POLICY_SHA256@@"
PRIOR_DOMAIN_RELEASE_SHA256 = "@@PRIOR_SHA256@@"
CURRENT_DOMAIN_RELEASE_SHA256 = "@@CURRENT_SHA256@@"

_POLICY: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(
    r"""@@POLICY_JSON@@"""
)
_PRIOR_RELEASE: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(
    r"""@@PRIOR_JSON@@"""
)
_CURRENT_RELEASE: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(
    r"""@@CURRENT_JSON@@"""
)
_SAFE_SEMVER = re.compile(
    r"^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,14}|[1-8][0-9]{15}|900719925474099[01])\."
    r"(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,14}|[1-8][0-9]{15}|900719925474099[01])\."
    r"(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,14}|[1-8][0-9]{15}|900719925474099[01])$"
)
_PORTABLE_ID = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[.:_-][a-z0-9]+){0,11}$")
_ADR_ID = re.compile(r"^ADR-[0-9]{4}$")
_SHA256_ID = re.compile(r"^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$")
_ROLES = ("desktop", "sidecar", "server")
_CHANGE_KINDS = (
    "add-optional-field",
    "widen-reader-type",
    "deprecate-field",
    "add-required-field",
    "remove-field",
    "rename-field",
    "narrow-reader-type",
    "add-closed-enum-member",
    "add-event-type",
    "change-event-payload",
    "change-identity-format",
    "repurpose-meaning",
)

type FrozenJson = None | bool | int | float | str | tuple["FrozenJson", ...] | Mapping[str, "FrozenJson"]


class DomainCompatibilityProblem(ValueError):
    def __init__(self, codes: Sequence[str]) -> None:
        self.codes = tuple(codes)
        super().__init__(self.codes[0] if self.codes else "compatibility-denied")


def _record(value: object) -> Mapping[str, Any] | None:
    return cast(Mapping[str, Any], value) if isinstance(value, Mapping) else None


def _deep_freeze(value: object) -> FrozenJson:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return MappingProxyType({str(key): _deep_freeze(item) for key, item in value.items()})
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return tuple(_deep_freeze(item) for item in value)
    return cast(None | bool | int | float | str, value)


def _exact_keys(value: Mapping[str, Any], keys: Sequence[str]) -> bool:
    return set(value) == set(keys)


def _is_semver(value: object) -> bool:
    return isinstance(value, str) and _SAFE_SEMVER.fullmatch(value) is not None


def _semver_parts(value: str) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    major, minor, patch = value.split(".")
    return int(major), int(minor), int(patch)


def _compare_semver(left: str, right: str) -> int:
    left_parts = _semver_parts(left)
    right_parts = _semver_parts(right)
    return (left_parts > right_parts) - (left_parts < right_parts)


def _ordered_versions(value: object) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) or not 1 <= len(value) <= 8 or not all(_is_semver(item) for item in value):
        return False
    versions = cast(Sequence[str], value)
    return all(index == 0 or _compare_semver(versions[index - 1], item) < 0 for index, item in enumerate(versions))


def _valid_relative_fixture(value: object) -> bool:
    return (
        isinstance(value, str)
        and 0 < len(value) <= 240
        and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+", value) is not None
        and not value.startswith("/")
        and re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", value) is None
        and ".." not in value.split("/")
    )


def domain_compatibility_policy() -> Mapping[str, FrozenJson]:
    return cast(Mapping[str, FrozenJson], _deep_freeze(_POLICY))


def contract_releases() -> tuple[Mapping[str, FrozenJson], Mapping[str, FrozenJson]]:
    return (
        cast(Mapping[str, FrozenJson], _deep_freeze(_PRIOR_RELEASE)),
        cast(Mapping[str, FrozenJson], _deep_freeze(_CURRENT_RELEASE)),
    )


def read_compatibility(version: object) -> Mapping[str, FrozenJson]:
    if version == _CURRENT_RELEASE["contractVersion"]:
        value = {
            "mode": "native",
            "contractVersion": version,
            "bridgeId": None,
            "diagnosticCode": "compatibility-read-native",
        }
    elif version == _PRIOR_RELEASE["contractVersion"]:
        value = {
            "mode": "bridge-required",
            "contractVersion": version,
            "bridgeId": "legacy-project-uuidv4-to-canonical-uuidv7",
            "diagnosticCode": "compatibility-read-bridge-required",
        }
    else:
        value = {
            "mode": "unsupported",
            "contractVersion": None,
            "bridgeId": None,
            "diagnosticCode": "compatibility-read-unsupported",
        }
    return cast(Mapping[str, FrozenJson], _deep_freeze(value))


def _basic_proposal(value: object) -> Mapping[str, Any] | None:
    proposal = _record(value)
    keys = (
        "schemaVersion",
        "documentType",
        "fromVersion",
        "toVersion",
        "changeKind",
        "artifactId",
        "adrId",
        "migration",
        "deprecation",
    )
    if proposal is None or not _exact_keys(proposal, keys):
        return None
    if (
        proposal["schemaVersion"] != "1.0"
        or proposal["documentType"] != "research-observatory-domain-change-proposal"
        or not _is_semver(proposal["fromVersion"])
        or not _is_semver(proposal["toVersion"])
    ):
        return None
    from_version = cast(str, proposal["fromVersion"])
    to_version = cast(str, proposal["toVersion"])
    if _compare_semver(from_version, to_version) >= 0 or proposal["changeKind"] not in _CHANGE_KINDS:
        return None
    artifact_id = proposal["artifactId"]
    if not isinstance(artifact_id, str) or len(artifact_id) > 128 or _PORTABLE_ID.fullmatch(artifact_id) is None:
        return None
    adr_id = proposal["adrId"]
    if adr_id is not None and (not isinstance(adr_id, str) or _ADR_ID.fullmatch(adr_id) is None):
        return None
    return proposal


def _valid_migration(value: object, from_version: str, to_version: str) -> str | None:
    migration = _record(value)
    keys = ("id", "fromVersion", "toVersion", "strategy", "sourceRetention", "testFixture")
    if migration is None or not _exact_keys(migration, keys):
        return "compatibility-breaking-migration-required"
    migration_id = migration["id"]
    if (
        not isinstance(migration_id, str)
        or _PORTABLE_ID.fullmatch(migration_id) is None
        or migration["strategy"] not in ("reader-bridge", "verified-copy-on-write")
        or migration["sourceRetention"] != "preserved"
        or not _valid_relative_fixture(migration["testFixture"])
    ):
        return "compatibility-breaking-migration-required"
    if migration["fromVersion"] != from_version or migration["toVersion"] != to_version:
        return "compatibility-migration-version-mismatch"
    return None


def _valid_deprecation(value: object, to_version: str) -> str | None:
    deprecation = _record(value)
    if deprecation is None or not _exact_keys(deprecation, ("since", "removalNotBefore", "replacement")):
        return "compatibility-deprecation-window-required"
    removal = deprecation["removalNotBefore"]
    replacement = deprecation["replacement"]
    if (
        deprecation["since"] != to_version
        or not _is_semver(removal)
        or _compare_semver(to_version, cast(str, removal)) >= 0
        or not isinstance(replacement, str)
        or _PORTABLE_ID.fullmatch(replacement) is None
    ):
        return "compatibility-deprecation-window-invalid"
    return None


def assess_domain_change(value: object) -> Mapping[str, FrozenJson]:
    proposal = _basic_proposal(value)
    if proposal is None:
        return cast(
            Mapping[str, FrozenJson],
            _deep_freeze(
                {
                    "classification": None,
                    "allowed": False,
                    "errors": ["compatibility-change-proposal-invalid"],
                    "diagnosticCode": "compatibility-change-denied",
                }
            ),
        )
    rules = cast(list[dict[str, Any]], _POLICY["changeRules"])
    rule = next(item for item in rules if item["changeKind"] == proposal["changeKind"])
    classification = cast(str, rule["classification"])
    errors: list[str] = []
    from_version = cast(str, proposal["fromVersion"])
    to_version = cast(str, proposal["toVersion"])
    from_major = _semver_parts(from_version)[0]
    to_major = _semver_parts(to_version)[0]
    if classification == "additive":
        if from_major != to_major:
            errors.append("compatibility-additive-major-change")
        if proposal["adrId"] is not None or proposal["migration"] is not None or proposal["deprecation"] is not None:
            errors.append("compatibility-additive-unexpected-authority")
    elif classification == "deprecation":
        if from_major != to_major:
            errors.append("compatibility-deprecation-major-change")
        error = _valid_deprecation(proposal["deprecation"], to_version)
        if error is not None:
            errors.append(error)
        if proposal["adrId"] is not None or proposal["migration"] is not None:
            errors.append("compatibility-deprecation-unexpected-authority")
    else:
        if to_major <= from_major:
            errors.append("compatibility-breaking-major-required")
        adr_id = proposal["adrId"]
        if not isinstance(adr_id, str) or _ADR_ID.fullmatch(adr_id) is None:
            errors.append("compatibility-breaking-adr-required")
        error = _valid_migration(proposal["migration"], from_version, to_version)
        if error is not None:
            errors.append(error)
        if proposal["deprecation"] is not None:
            errors.append("compatibility-breaking-unexpected-deprecation")
    return cast(
        Mapping[str, FrozenJson],
        _deep_freeze(
            {
                "classification": classification,
                "allowed": not errors,
                "errors": errors,
                "diagnosticCode": "compatibility-change-accepted" if not errors else "compatibility-change-denied",
            }
        ),
    )


def _valid_advertisement(value: object) -> bool:
    item = _record(value)
    keys = (
        "schemaVersion",
        "documentType",
        "role",
        "componentVersion",
        "contractFamily",
        "supportedContractVersions",
        "supportedEventVersions",
        "schemaSetId",
    )
    if item is None or not _exact_keys(item, keys):
        return False
    schema_set_id = item["schemaSetId"]
    return (
        item["schemaVersion"] == "1.0"
        and item["documentType"] == "research-observatory-domain-compatibility-advertisement"
        and item["role"] in _ROLES
        and _is_semver(item["componentVersion"])
        and item["contractFamily"] == "research-observatory-domain"
        and _ordered_versions(item["supportedContractVersions"])
        and _ordered_versions(item["supportedEventVersions"])
        and isinstance(schema_set_id, str)
        and _SHA256_ID.fullmatch(schema_set_id) is not None
    )


def _common_highest(items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], key: str) -> str | None:
    first = cast(Sequence[str], items[0][key])
    common = [version for version in first if all(version in cast(Sequence[str], item[key]) for item in items)]
    return max(common, key=_semver_parts) if common else None


def domain_compatibility_negotiation_errors(value: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if (
        not isinstance(value, (list, tuple))
        or not 2 <= len(value) <= 3
        or not all(_valid_advertisement(item) for item in value)
    ):
        return ("compatibility-advertisement-invalid",)
    items = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], value)
    roles = [cast(str, item["role"]) for item in items]
    if len(set(roles)) != len(roles):
        return ("compatibility-role-duplicate",)
    if "desktop" not in roles or "sidecar" not in roles:
        return ("compatibility-required-role-missing",)
    if len({item["contractFamily"] for item in items}) != 1:
        return ("compatibility-family-mismatch",)
    if len({item["schemaSetId"] for item in items}) != 1:
        return ("compatibility-schema-set-mismatch",)
    if _common_highest(items, "supportedContractVersions") is None:
        return ("compatibility-contract-version-no-overlap",)
    if _common_highest(items, "supportedEventVersions") is None:
        return ("compatibility-event-version-no-overlap",)
    return ()


def negotiate_domain_compatibility(value: object) -> Mapping[str, FrozenJson]:
    errors = domain_compatibility_negotiation_errors(value)
    if errors:
        raise DomainCompatibilityProblem(errors)
    items = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], value)
    contract_version = _common_highest(items, "supportedContractVersions")
    event_version = _common_highest(items, "supportedEventVersions")
    if contract_version is None or event_version is None:
        raise DomainCompatibilityProblem(("compatibility-denied",))
    roles = tuple(role for role in _ROLES if any(item["role"] == role for item in items))
    result = {
        "schemaVersion": "1.0",
        "documentType": "research-observatory-domain-compatibility-negotiation",
        "contractVersion": contract_version,
        "eventVersion": event_version,
        "schemaSetId": items[0]["schemaSetId"],
        "roles": roles,
        "diagnosticCode": "compatibility-negotiated",
    }
    return cast(Mapping[str, FrozenJson], _deep_freeze(result))
